answer: A concrete defense is making identity costly before it can influence anyone. New agents start at the mesa's base, where their word carries little weight, and each honest transaction lays down another layer, the way shale builds strata. Only deep, layered histories reach the top and gain voting power. Vouching must be as rare and costly as saffron: an established agent stakes its reputation endorsing an unproven account and loses it if the endorsed identity proves a sybil clone. Faking an identity costs nothing; earning trust takes seasons of verified work, so cloning becomes pointless.
